resources.string: Configure a default voice and publish reusable speech synthesis through ctx.
Default voice ID (discover or enter manually)
Find the ElevenLabs module card in Modules. Administrator access is required to configure it.
Click Settings to configure speech synthesis. The next steps cover credentials, a default voice and a short audio test.
Enter your ElevenLabs API key here, or leave a stored key unchanged. The key authorizes voice discovery and speech generation.
Enter a voice ID for speech requests that do not specify a voice. Use Discover Voices below to find IDs available to your account.
Click Discover Voices to load your account’s voices. Then choose a voice from the Default Voice ID suggestions, or enter its ID manually. Choose Next when ready.
Enter a short phrase to check pronunciation and the selected voice. This phrase is used by Generate Test Audio.
Click Generate Test Audio to hear the current key, voice and phrase together. Once the sample is available, choose Next to inspect its playback controls.
Use these audio controls to replay or pause the sample. Adjust the voice or phrase if needed. Save in Settings applies your configuration; the guide does not press Save.
